summary:
EVIDENCE GATHERING COMPLETE

1. The vulnerability: T1 (Affected products: Windows Server 2012-2025; Fixed build for W06's OS [Server 2022]: 10.0.20348.5622; CVSS: 9.8, CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H)
2. The asset record: T2 (OS: Windows Server 2022; Build: 10.0.20348.5499; KBs: KB5120242; Services: Print Spooler, Central print queues, DNS Server; Zone: APPS; Host count: 2)
3. Scope: T2 (W06 is the only asset running the DNS Server role)
4. Reachability: T3 (Network paths: Internal domain-joined devices can reach W06 on ports 53/tcp, 53/udp; Perimeter policy: Deny unsolicited inbound; Internet exposure: DNS is not published to the Internet)
5. Business impact: T4 (Business service: BS05 "Collaboration and general files"; Consequence: Work interruption or confidential document disclosure; RTO: 24h; RPO: 8h)
6. Known exploitation: T5 (Not in CISA KEV)
7. Exploit activity and remediation context: T6 (Vendor assessment: Publicly disclosed No, Exploited No, Exploitability "More Likely"; Official fix available)
